comment_only_delta.method: extract the committed b51 DSO from `git show HEAD:artifacts/phase2/install/lib/libcrypto.so.3`, compare it with the b51b working-tree rebuild; dump each ELF section with objcopy, hash with sha256, locate byte differences with cmp, and decode each differing .data.rel.ro word as the `line` field of a 24-byte panic `Location` (file &str at +0, len at +8, line u32 at +16, col u32 at +20)

data_rel_ro.interpretation: every differing word is a panic `Location.line`; the file path, path length and column are unchanged in all eight records, and each line moved by +8, matching the +8 comment lines inserted into v3_asid.rs and v3_info.rs before those call sites

archives.note: all 352 members of each archive were extracted with `ar p` and compared section-by-section; no code-section byte differs

symbol_tables.difference: the differing names differ only in the LLVM `.llvm.<hash>` suffix digits; the demangled names are identical
symbol_tables.strtab_size: 0x200cbb (b51) -> 0x1ff213 (b51b), accounted for by the differing suffix digit counts

comment_only_delta.conclusion: byte identity between the b51 and b51b artefacts is not achievable on this toolchain for a comment-only source edit: panic Location line constants and LLVM CGU hash suffixes are embedded in the outputs. The code-bearing sections are byte-identical for the DSOs (and for every checked archive member), so code equivalence holds; the digests necessarily differ.
